title: VisualMontage: Manipulating the Beliefs of Vision-Language Agents with Authentic Image Sequences
abstract: arXiv:2611.34603v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As agents based on vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly interpret social-media content, errors in their analysis may lend credibility to rumors and amplify their spread. In this paper, we study the problem of visual cognitive collusion, in which coordinated posts combine authentic images and locally faithful captions to induce VLM agents to infer and accept attacker-chosen target claims through their own reasoning. To enable systematic evaluation of this cognitive threat, we introduce a new benchmark comprising 544 target cases and 33.2K candidate images across eight application domains. We further propose VisualMontage, a multi-agent framework for simulating such attacks through narrative planning, image selection and ordering, and caption assignment under iterative review. translated_title: VisualMontage：利用真实图像序列操纵视觉语言智能体的信念
translated_abstract: 随着基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的智能体越来越多地解读社交媒体内容，其分析中的错误可能会为谣言提供可信度并放大其传播。本文研究了“视觉认知合谋”问题，即协同发布的帖子将真实图像与局部可信的说明文字相结合，诱导VLM智能体通过自身推理过程推断并接受攻击者选定的目标论断。为了实现对这一认知威胁的系统性评估，我们引入了一个新基准，涵盖八个应用领域的544个目标案例和33.2K张候选图像。我们进一步提出了VisualMontage，一个多智能体框架，通过叙事规划、图像选择与排序以及迭代审查下的说明文字分配来模拟此类攻击。我们通过对12个视觉语言模型的大量实验评估了这一威胁，考察了模态效应、制作团队组件以及下游影响。
tldr: 本文提出VisualMontage多智能体攻击框架，通过将真实图像与局部可信的说明文字组合成精心规划的叙事序列，可诱导视觉语言模型智能体通过自身推理接受攻击者选定的错误论断，并构建了包含8个领域544个案例、33.2K张图像的基准对12个VLM进行了系统评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes VisualMontage, a multi-agent framework that combines authentic images with locally faithful captions into planned narrative sequences to induce vision-language agents to infer and accept attacker-chosen claims through their own reasoning, with a new benchmark of 544 cases and 33.2K images across 12 VLMs.
